question: Which of the following Tiger Reserves was granted the 'Conservation Assured Tiger Standards' status in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mudumalai Tiger Reserve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mudumalai Tiger Reserve **is among the** Tiger Reserves **which was granted the **'Conservation Assured Tiger Standards' status in July 2021.**
